name: Allah be praised with an...
arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا)).

transliterations.latin: Elhamdulil-lahi hamden kethiren tajjiben mubareken fihi, gajre [mekfijjin ve la] muvedde’in, ve la mustagnen anhu Rabbena

translations.albanian: E Falënderojmë Allahun me Falënderime të shumta, të mira dhe të bekuara [të cilat janë të pamjaftueshme], Falënderime të pandërprera, për të cilat kemi nevojë, o Zoti ynë.
translations.english: (Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.)(There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)
translations.indonesian: Ya Allah! Hujanilah di sekitar kami, jangan kepada kami. Ya, Allah! Berilah hujan ke daratan tinggi, beberapa anak bukit perut lembah dan beberapa tanah yang menumbuhkan pepohonan." 195 Doa Melihat Bulan Tanggal Satu
